why: The concept decides the clothes (owner, 2026-10-13, through the overseer and the captain): a cast place's people wear the colour its cast record's words give them (the surface method's own rule: name from the picture, library surface by name: of the people place's fabrics the words name, the nearest by dE, used only within dE 32 of the measured torso), on every fabric surface of the outfit but a print. The torso colour is measured on the concept (the median of each figure's torso, rows 30-60% and columns 30-70% of SAM 3's box) and recorded with its CIE76 dE, but not used to choose: the concepts are dim, warm-lit rooms, so a torso's lightness is the room's light, not the cloth's, and by dE every place's nearest fabric is wool_charcoal.

camp.hue_against_words: the torso's hue is warmer (a 6.1, b 9.8) than olive_drab's (a -5.1, b 15.8)

not_coloured.greenhouse: khaki coveralls: no library surface lies within dE 32 of the measured torso (canvas_beige 64.8, the nearest khaki-like name); left in the painted colours until a khaki surface is added (captain, 2026-10-13)
